blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Delays in infrastructure flagship projects (IFPs) targeted for completion by 2028 have become a growing concern, as these could hamper the recovery in public investments that the government is counting on to prop up the weak economy, Socioeconomic Planning Secretary Arsenio Balisacan said.
